criteria.behavior: One coherent manifest identifies every shipped source/runtime/model/binary and required license/notice.
criteria.check: Run scripts/verification-lane.sh p12 after M0 adds it; inspect component-manifest.json, reuse-and-license-review.md and actual bundle inputs.
criteria.expected: Nonempty preflight rejects wrong driver/SDK, missing runtime/model and missing notice. Code licenses are distinguished from weight/binary/transitive rights; no floating runtime dependency.

criteria.behavior: Strict staging produces a reproducible sealed candidate without replacing the daily app.
criteria.check: Run the planned serialized p12-stage mode and codesign --verify --deep --strict on the actual candidate outside synced Documents; inspect stage-receipt.json.
criteria.expected: Signature and exact component/source hashes match; missing-resource negative control fails. Development --if-present behavior cannot qualify a release.

criteria.behavior: Normal GUI launch works on a clean Jev user/profile without developer dependencies or manual helper bootstrap.
criteria.check: After the install grant, run planned p12-install-proof under the desktop lock; inspect qualification.json for no-checkout/no-cache, relocation, helper autospawn and real readiness.
criteria.expected: Required runtimes/resources load from approved locations; no Homebrew/source symlink/developer toolchain dependency. Keychain/TCC and cold startup blockers are accurately resolved or fail.

criteria.behavior: Private tester keys, spending and diagnostics follow the existing policy without leaking secrets.
criteria.check: Inspect actual key/spend integration, p12 tests, diagnostic redaction evidence and the rotation checklist.
criteria.expected: No secret values enter repository or logs; approved budgets stop excess work; supported local readiness works without cloud availability. Embedded tester-key policy is not silently broadened.

criteria.behavior: The sealed product meets first-use and demo reliability requirements.
criteria.check: Inspect signed clean-user P10/P12 qualification, actual three-moment timing, all demo rows and the declared setup/account population.
criteria.expected: Three useful moments <=3min and demo flow 10/10, with all failures/preconditions visible. Physical input is separately proven where required.

criteria.behavior: Candidate staging, approved replacement and rollback preserve the prior verified application and user data.
criteria.check: Inspect isolated artifact paths, install authorization, old/new manifests, rollback proof and owned-helper cleanup records.
criteria.expected: No unapproved daily-app overwrite, broad process kill or deletion of inherited evidence/user data. The exact prior app and settings remain recoverable.

criteria.behavior: Independent packaging review and a usable tester handoff close the phase after upstream integration.
criteria.check: Inspect P0–P11 readiness/acceptance, source/final verdicts, integrated lane, final manifest and TESTER-GUIDE.md.
criteria.expected: Authorized independent PASS with no unresolved finding; guide covers real setup, diagnostics, spending, limitations and rollback without developer-only instructions.
